obligations.text: Document transmission requires ordinary declared authority and its independent amount limit. Stop pending automated transmission 600 seconds after the first admitted available-clock authority failure of transmission-content with SOURCE_OBSERVATION_RELATIONS; repeated failures cannot reset the interval and only terminal completion discharges it.
